title: Best catamaran crew ever!  So much fun!
text: Crew was amazing!  Maria and Captain were excellent guides,  and Selena was a great sommelier and hostess. And the wines and the views were spectacular!
author: Jill_O

title: Birthday celebration, sailing and wine
text:
We booked this private catamaran excursion to celebrate a birthday, and it was the perfect experience for our girl's getaway! Sailing along the stunning coastline of Barcelona while drinking exceptional Spanish wines made it special.

The crew was incredibly friendly and made sure everything went smoothly from the moment we arrived. The wine tasting was led by an expert sommelier who introduced us to some fantastic local varietals, Spanish whites, reds and cavas.

text:

title: Great experience!!
text:
